name: scatter-rain-text
title: Scatter Rain Text
description: On in-view, glyphs fall from above with per-letter delay, rotation and a tiny bounce, then stay put — a controlled storm where each drop lands on its own baseline slot, spring-free and transition-only.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Airy
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- In View Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
